package.description: An advanced presence and notification device for Webex on Windows

en-US.author: Plenom A/S
en-US.description: An advanced presence and notification device for Webex on Windows
en-US.longDescription: kuando Busylight is a presence, call alert, and notification system designed to eliminate distractions while keeping you updated on calls, events, and emails. The simple but effective productivity device displays your presence status in real-time while the built-in speaker signals incoming calls, making it a natural addition to Webex on Windows.
en-US.name: kuando Busylight for Webex

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 上 Webex 的高级状态和通知设备
zh-CN.longDescription: kuando Busylight 是一款状态提示、来电提醒和通知系统，旨在消除干扰的同时让您及时了解来电、事件和邮件信息。这款简单而高效的生产力设备可实时显示您的在线状态，内置扬声器可提示来电，是 Webex 在 Windows 上使用的自然补充。
